failure_policy: Every task writes one row, including explicit failures; no failed row is dropped.

pilot.description: Every campaign type; two source seeds; low/high sample endpoints; n=80 and n=100 operational smoke tasks.

hidden_information_policy: Hidden SCM/DAG/target metadata is construction/evaluation-only. Only controlled orientation corruption uses the hidden DAG to create a labeled wrong direction.
pairing_policy: Stage-B source ID plus deterministic sample-prefix seeds; never row order.
